Need to search specifically for perigee and marathon record details using python re/web_search to be precise.
Let's search for "perigee" on the Moon page text or search web for minimum perigee value on Wikipedia Moon page and Eliud Kipchoge world record marathon time.
```python
search_res = await web_search(query="site:en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon perigee minimum km")
print(search_res)
```
